transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Um, hi. I guess... things just got kind of out of hand at work. I'm usually just a regular crew guy doing landscaping, but... I don't know. I started trying to run three bids at once. Calling city people, lining up plant suppliers... messaging everyone I knew about this park idea. It was just... like I couldn't shut it off. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you had a period in the last few weeks where you felt unusually energetic, elevated, or irritable for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least four days in a row?

Yeah... I guess so. Before I crashed, I was just... really fired up. Felt kind of... bigger than myself, I guess. But, um... if one of the guys on the crew questioned my plan, or told me to slow down... I'd just snap at him. Like, way harder than made sense. So... yeah. It was like that for a while.

Have you ever had a period where your mood was extremely elevated or irritable, and your energy was so high that it significantly interfered with your ability to function normally — maybe even leading to problems at work, with relationships, or needing less sleep than usual?
Um... no, not really. I mean, not like that. I just... I get fired up sometimes, like I said. But it doesn't... I still go to work. I don't know about all that other stuff.
During that time when you felt really fired up, did you also need a lot less sleep than usual — like only a few hours a night — and still feel rested or energized?
Um... yeah, I guess I wasn't sleeping much. Maybe a few hours. But I wasn't tired. I just... kept going.
When you were feeling this way, did you find your thoughts racing, or did you feel like you were doing a lot more activities than usual — like work, social, or goal-directed tasks?

Yeah, I guess. My head was just... running fast. Mostly just thinking about work stuff. Plant lists... layouts for the parks, slogans... who I needed to impress. Stuff like that. I'd just... I'd fill up whole pages in a notebook trying to get it all down, but... I still felt behind. Just a lot going on up there.
Have you ever had a time when you felt so energized or in such a heightened mood that it was noticeably different from your usual self, and this lasted for a week or more?

I mean... yeah. I guess it was a couple of weeks. When I was trying to... you know, redo everything for that park pitch. I just felt really dialed in for about two weeks, trying to get it all perfect. And then... I don't know, I just kind of crashed after that.

During that time when you felt so energized and were working so intensely, did it ever get to the point where you were unable to do your usual work or had serious problems in your relationships because of it?
I don't think so. I was just working. I don't really know if it caused problems. I was just doing my job.
Did the way you were feeling during that time cause any serious problems with your coworkers or make it hard for you to do your job the way you normally would?
No. Like I said... I was just doing my job. Nobody complained to me or anything. I was just getting the landscaping done. It didn't make it hard to work... I was actually working more. So, no.
Have you ever had a time when your mood was so high or your behavior was so out of the ordinary that other people noticed and it caused real problems in your relationships or at work?

I mean... no. I don't really know what else to tell you. I feel like I just said, it wasn't like that. Nobody told me I was acting weird or... whatever. It didn't ruin anything. I was just doing my thing.

Have you ever had a period where your mood was so high or your behavior so extreme that you needed hospitalization, did something extremely risky or out of character, or were unable to function in your usual daily life?
No. Never been in a hospital for anything like that. I don't really do crazy stuff, either. Just work and go home. I can always do what I need to do.

Looking back, would you say that your behavior during that high-energy period was so extreme that it interfered with your ability to function in your daily life, even if others didn't point it out or confront you directly?
No, I... I already said no. It didn't mess anything up. I was fine. Just getting things done. I don't know why we keep going over this.
Have you ever had a time when you felt so unusually confident or powerful — like you didn’t need sleep, or that you could do things no one else could — and this feeling lasted for at least a week?
No. I don't... I don't feel like a superhero or anything. I just felt good for a few days. Not a whole week. And I still slept, just... less. I don't know.
